description: Form input used to select single number from the linear range. A simple alternative to a standard number input.

props.appendInnerIcon: Creates a [v-icon](/api/v-icon/) inside the end of the track. Requires the **pill** variant.
props.centered: Fills the track from its center to the thumb instead of from the start.
props.prependInnerIcon: Creates a [v-icon](/api/v-icon/) inside the start of the track. Requires the **pill** variant.

slots.append-inner: Slot for content inside the end of the track. Requires the **pill** variant.
slots.prepend-inner: Slot for content inside the start of the track. Requires the **pill** variant.

events.end: Slider value emitted at the end of slider movement.
events.start: Slider value emitted at start of slider movement.
